Toronto Raptors — injuries
Leonard (knee) is continuing the reconditioning process, and another update will be provided in one week, Blake Murphy of Sportsnet.ca reports.
With Leonard still in the rehab phase of his recovery from left knee swelling, there remains no indication of an imminent return to game action. The one-week update timeline suggests Toronto is continuing to monitor his progress before advancing to the next step, keeping his near-term availability uncertain.
